code_python3:
class Solution:
    def verticalTraversal(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> List[List[int]]:
        from collections import defaultdict
        nodes = []
        def dfs(node, r, c):
            if not node: return
            nodes.append((c, r, node.val))
            dfs(node.left, r+1, c-1)
            dfs(node.right, r+1, c+1)
        dfs(root, 0, 0)
        nodes.sort()
        res, prev_col = [], None
        for c, r, v in nodes:
            if c != prev_col:
                res.append([])
                prev_col = c
            res[-1].append(v)
        return res

code_python3:
class Solution:
    def numSquarefulPerms(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        from math import isqrt
        nums.sort()
        n = len(nums)
        used = [False]*n
        self.res = 0
        def bt(path):
            if len(path) == n:
                self.res += 1
                return
            for i in range(n):
                if used[i]: continue
                if i > 0 and nums[i]==nums[i-1] and not used[i-1]: continue
                if path and not is_sq(path[-1]+nums[i]): continue
                used[i] = True
                bt(path+[nums[i]])
                used[i] = False
        def is_sq(x):
            s = isqrt(x)
            return s*s == x
        bt([])
        return self.res
